page.notes: The scan shows a printed index page. The last line of the Maccabees entry is partly in the right margin and reads "lymam" ending the word "Hierosolymam"; the margin fragment is transcribed as printed in the line above. The bottom of the entry continues beyond the scan edge, so the final word may be incomplete. Some letters in the 16th-century type are worn and "Eliam" and "obtulisti" are read with some uncertainty. The Greek and Hebrew terms are not used on this page.
